note: Private campground on the south edge of Hot Springs, beside a small spring-fed lake for swimming, catch-and-release fishing and free kayaks, canoes and paddle boards; gravel back-in and pull-through pads, cabins, playground. Water hydrants are shared between pairs of sites. Monthly rentals from mid-September to mid-May. --Claude
summary: Operator site read (rates, campground, site-type, long-term and general-info pages): full hookups 20/30/50 A on every site, pads to 75 ft; 2027 nightly $38-70 (cheapest RV night $38, under the price gate); open year-round for RV sites, facilities May 1-Oct 1; monthly rentals only mid-Sep to mid-May. Google 4.7 from 164 reviews. Not waterfront kept (RV rows sit below the pond's dam). Pin fine.
flags: PRICE GATE: passes - cheapest real RV night $38 (back-in, spring/fall; operator's 2027 estimate). Stored $38-42 was a single October search; widened to 38-70 from the published range.

LONG-STAY: monthly RV rentals ($750/$825) are offered only mid-September to mid-May; summer is nightly with nightly marketing and multi-night discounts, no minimum stay. About 20 rigs on imagery - nightly share not measurable from imagery, but the operator's wording does not discourage nightly guests. No flag.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept - the RV rows sit south-east of and below the pond's dam (operator: 'walk across the dam'), with the office and drive between; the pond is ~35 m from the nearest pad over the embankment (below-the-dam rule).
SITES: no site count published - stored count absent stays absent; max_rig_ft 75 written from the pull-through pad length.
FACILITIES: the long-term page says the shower house opens 'May 15 to October 1' while the site pages say 'May 1 to October 1' - used May 1.
DISCOUNTS: stored military true (5%, from ResNexus 2026-10-14) not re-read - ResNexus not opened (Incapsula rule); the operator's rates page mentions only multi-night discounts.
FIRE: operator posts a fire ban for the 2026 season (no open fires or charcoal) - seasonal, not in the note.
PIN: stored 43.44890,-103.48100 is in the grass ~30 m east of the RV rows - fine.
PHONE: 605-745-4042 matches the operator site and Google - fine. WEBSITE: both stored lines kept.
